title: Regional micro-map navigation (Thornwold's ~15-room wood, Barrowmere's downs) has no reliable landmark-to-landmark travel until every room is manually visited, so finding a specific named location (e.g. Iron Downs' north track, the Weeping Cairn) took many blind directional guesses and backtracking loops.
